import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_94/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_94/test_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_94/test_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_94/test_3.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_94/test_4.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_94/test_5.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_94/test_6.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_94/test_7.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_94/test_8.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_94/test_9.csv"
    ]

    # Target schema columns and types
    target_columns = ['admit', 'gre', 'gpa', 'prestige']
    target_dtypes = {
        'admit': 'int64',
        'gre': 'int64',
        'gpa': 'float64',
        'prestige': 'int64'
    }

    # Read all source files, ensure schema and types, then concatenate
    dfs = []
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

        # Ensure columns are exactly the target columns
        df = df[target_columns]

        # Convert columns to target types
        df = df.astype(target_dtypes)

        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all dataframes vertically (union all rows)
    target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Write the combined dataframe to the target CSV file
    target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_94/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
